small_guidance:
- The IC loop is the innermost and runs 32 sequential iterations per (kd,kh,kw); tile IC into a BLOCK_IC dimension (e.g. 8 or 16) and use `tl.dot` of [BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_IC] × [BLOCK_IC, BLOCK_SP] to get tensor-core throughput instead of scalar FMAs.
- Add a `triton.autotune` sweep over (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SP, BLOCK_IC, num_warps, num_stages): try BLOCK_OC ∈ {32,64}, BLOCK_SP ∈ {64,128,256}, BLOCK_IC ∈ {8,16,32}, num_warps ∈ {4,8}, num_stages ∈ {2,3,4}.
- Hoist the per-(kd,kh,kw) `spatial_valid` mask and `in_spatial_idx_safe` computation outside the IC loop (already partly done) and remove the dead `add_bias` load to cut register pressure.
large_guidance:
- Restructure as an im2col-style GEMM: for ConvTranspose3d this means a scatter-add formulation where each program tile loads an [IC, BLOCK_SP_in] input panel and an [IC, BLOCK_OC] weight panel, computes a [BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_SP_in] outer product per (kd,kh,kw), and scatters to the output — collapsing the IC reduction into one `tl.dot` per kernel offset.
- Alternatively, use the gather formulation but make GEMM-K = IC × KD × KH × KW be the contracted axis with a `tl.dot` of [BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_K] × [BLOCK_K, BLOCK_SP]; precompute the per-K input offsets and validity masks in registers and stream through with `num_stages=3` software pipelining.
- Switch the output layout to channels-last (N, OD, OH, OW, OC) so the OC axis is contiguous and the add_input + hardswish epilogue does coalesced vector loads/stores; transpose weight to (OC, IC, KD, KH, KW) at init so the M-major GEMM-K stream is contiguous.
